backup_restores_discard_check.name: backup_restores_discard_check
backup_restores_discard_check.value: ("backup_restores"."status" = 'discarded') = ("backup_restores"."discarded_at" is not null) and ("backup_restores"."discarded_at" is null) = ("backup_restores"."discarded_by" is null)

class_group_modules_module_live_uidx.name: class_group_modules_module_live_uidx
class_group_modules_module_live_uidx.where: "class_group_modules"."deleted_at" is null and "class_group_modules"."module" is not null

class_groups_dates_check.name: class_groups_dates_check
class_groups_dates_check.value: "class_groups"."status" = 'draft' or ("class_groups"."starts_on" is not null and "class_groups"."ends_on" is not null)

class_groups_enrollment_window_check.name: class_groups_enrollment_window_check
class_groups_enrollment_window_check.value: "class_groups"."enrollment_opens_at" is null or "class_groups"."enrollment_closes_at" is null or "class_groups"."enrollment_opens_at" < "class_groups"."enrollment_closes_at"

class_groups_erased_check.name: class_groups_erased_check
class_groups_erased_check.value: "class_groups"."erased_at" is null or "class_groups"."deleted_at" is not null

complaint_events_answer_check.name: complaint_events_answer_check
complaint_events_answer_check.value: ("complaint_events"."kind" = 'answered' and length(btrim("complaint_events"."answer")) between 1 and 5000) or ("complaint_events"."kind" <> 'answered' and "complaint_events"."answer" is null)

complaints_national_id_type_check.name: complaints_national_id_type_check
complaints_national_id_type_check.value: "complaints"."consumer_national_id_type" in ('DNI', 'CE', 'passport') and ("complaints"."guardian_national_id_type" is null or "complaints"."guardian_national_id_type" in ('DNI', 'CE', 'passport'))

courses_landing_key_live_uidx.name: courses_landing_key_live_uidx
courses_landing_key_live_uidx.where: "courses"."landing_key" is not null and "courses"."deleted_at" is null

documents_uploaded_check.name: documents_uploaded_check
documents_uploaded_check.value: ("documents"."status" in ('uploaded', 'removed')) = ("documents"."uploaded_at" is not null and "documents"."size_bytes" is not null and "documents"."checksum_sha256" is not null)

documents_removed_check.name: documents_removed_check
documents_removed_check.value: ("documents"."status" = 'removed') = ("documents"."deleted_at" is not null) and ("documents"."status" = 'removed') = ("documents"."removed_by" is not null)

email_verifications_consumed_check.name: email_verifications_consumed_check
email_verifications_consumed_check.value: "email_verifications"."consumed_at" is null or "email_verifications"."verified_at" is not null

grade_corrections_value_check.name: grade_corrections_value_check
grade_corrections_value_check.value: ("grade_corrections"."did_not_sit" and "grade_corrections"."score" is null) or (not "grade_corrections"."did_not_sit" and "grade_corrections"."score" between 0 and 20)

grade_corrections_reason_check.name: grade_corrections_reason_check
grade_corrections_reason_check.value: ("grade_corrections"."kind" = 'teacher_edit' and "grade_corrections"."reason" is null) or ("grade_corrections"."kind" = 'correction' and length(btrim("grade_corrections"."reason")) between 1 and 500)

grade_register_events_note_check.name: grade_register_events_note_check
grade_register_events_note_check.value: ("grade_register_events"."kind" = 'returned' and length(btrim("grade_register_events"."note")) between 1 and 1000) or ("grade_register_events"."kind" <> 'returned' and "grade_register_events"."note" is null)

grades_value_check.name: grades_value_check
grades_value_check.value: ("grades"."did_not_sit" and "grades"."score" is null) or (not "grades"."did_not_sit" and "grades"."score" between 0 and 20)

issued_documents_source_check.name: issued_documents_source_check
issued_documents_source_check.value:
("issued_documents"."kind" = 'enrollment_certificate') = ("issued_documents"."procedure_request_id" is not null)
        and ("issued_documents"."kind" = 'certificate') = ("issued_documents"."class_group_module_id" is not null)

payments_decided_by_check.name: payments_decided_by_check
payments_decided_by_check.value: "decided_by" is null or "decided_at" is not null

receipt_uploads_screen_pending_idx.name: receipt_uploads_screen_pending_idx
receipt_uploads_screen_pending_idx.where: "receipt_uploads"."status" = 'processed' and "receipt_uploads"."payment_id" is not null and "receipt_uploads"."screened_at" is null

receipt_uploads_validate_pending_idx.name: receipt_uploads_validate_pending_idx
receipt_uploads_validate_pending_idx.where: "receipt_uploads"."payment_id" is not null and "receipt_uploads"."screened_at" is not null and "receipt_uploads"."validated_at" is null

staff_invites_teacher_check.name: staff_invites_teacher_check
staff_invites_teacher_check.value: ("staff_invites"."teacher_id" is null or "staff_invites"."role" = 'teacher') and ("staff_invites"."role" <> 'teacher' or "staff_invites"."status" <> 'pending' or "staff_invites"."teacher_id" is not null)

staff_profiles_name_live_uidx.name: staff_profiles_name_live_uidx
staff_profiles_name_live_uidx.where: "staff_profiles"."deleted_at" is null and "staff_profiles"."name" is not null

teacher_contracts_file_check.name: teacher_contracts_file_check
teacher_contracts_file_check.value: ("teacher_contracts"."object_key" is null) = ("teacher_contracts"."file_name" is null) and ("teacher_contracts"."object_key" is null) = ("teacher_contracts"."file_size_bytes" is null)

teacher_contracts_source_check.name: teacher_contracts_source_check
teacher_contracts_source_check.value: "teacher_contracts"."object_key" is not null or "teacher_contracts"."template_version_id" is not null
